Dash is now flying straight
Fixed flying enemies

notes.title: Little Droid 1.0.20
notes.notes:
Increased running speed.
Decreased the cost of purchasing lives and energy

notes.title: Little Droid 1.0.19
notes.notes: Now you can move and zoom the camera

notes.title: Little Droid 1.0.18
notes.notes:
Now pressing buttons is saved.
Changed 2nd boss, now it doesn't fly behind the wall, and you can hit it when it flies.

notes.title: Little Droid 1.0.16
notes.notes:
Fixed 2 boss.
Now you can change weapons when the player crouched (previously the player immediately stood up after changing weapons)

notes.title: Little Droid 1.0.14
notes.notes:
Minor fixes for bosses.
Added translation of final titles.
Now whoever completes the game and posts it on YouTube will be added to the game titles.

notes.title: LittleDroid 1.0.13
notes.notes:
The second boss has been fixed.
Boss Golem has been slightly buffed.
Increased damage to weapons (Green Splash) and last weapon.

notes.title: Little Droid 1.0.12
notes.notes:
Fixed during the last portal.
Added save space in the last zone.
Now you can see where the flying enemy appears (in the last zone)
The health of the flying enemy has been slightly reduced

notes.title: Little Droid 1.0.11
notes.notes:
Fixed life purchase price.
Before bosses appear, you can now see where he will appear.
Secret places can now be spotted.

notes.title: Little Droid 1.0.9
notes.notes:
HP purchase price reduced
You can hide in front of the 2nd and 3rd boss

notes.title: Little Droid 1.0.7
notes.notes:
fixed (It was impossible to jump after a dash).
You can now shoot while holding down the button
